freeTrial.title: Free trial
freeTrial.description: Control access, delivery and email protection.

enabled.label: Enable free trial
enabled.description: Allow one protected trial per eligible user and device.

emailCode.label: Send redeem code by email
emailCode.description: Users enter the code from their inbox before activation.

emailRisk.label: AI email risk review
emailRisk.description: Review suspicious domains asynchronously. AI alone never blocks an address.

allowance.label: Trial allowance
allowance.description: Applied to every new free trial.

ocrUpload.title: OCR upload compression
ocrUpload.description: Control how chapter images are prepared on the phone before OCR upload.

master.label: Compress images on phone
master.enabled: A compression profile is applied before upload.
master.disabled: Original images are uploaded without resizing or WebP re-encoding.

reduction.reference: Reference reductions measured on Chapter 339. Actual size varies by chapter.

custom.title: Custom profile
custom.maximumWidthHelp: Range 800–2400 px. Smaller widths may remove small text.
custom.coordinateDescription: OCR blocks are automatically mapped back to the high-quality source images.
custom.sizeWarning: Final file size cannot be guaranteed. It depends on each chapter.

rollout.title: Rollout scope
rollout.testHelp: Start with internal devices before applying the profile globally.
rollout.percentageHelp: The same deterministic group of installations receives the policy.
rollout.allHelp: Apply this profile to every compatible phone.
rollout.installationIdsHelp: One installation ID per line, up to 20 devices.

warnings.experimental: A visually readable image can still lose small OCR text. Validate experimental profiles before promotion.
warnings.original: Original bypass is active. The phone uploads the source images without compression.
